NPM_PATH.description: Path to the npm binary. Use this if npm is not in your system PATH.

NPM_TOKEN.description: npm authentication token. Can be generated from npmjs.com > Account > Access Tokens. If omitted, the server will use credentials from your ~/.npmrc (from running npm login).
